@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Upload PO - Itens (Intf.)'
define view entity ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP_I
  as select from zexed_up_pdcmp_i

  association [1..1] to ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP               as _File                         on  $projection.FileUUID = _File.UUID

  association [0..1] to I_ProductText                  as _MaterialText                 on  $projection.Material   = _MaterialText.Product
                                                                                        and _MaterialText.Language = $session.system_language

  association [0..1] to I_Plant                        as _Plant                        on  $projection.Plant = _Plant.Plant

  association [0..1] to I_AcctAssgmtDistrIndicatorTxt  as _AcctAssgmtDistrIndicatorText on  _AcctAssgmtDistrIndicatorText.Language     = $session.system_language
                                                                                        and $projection.MultipleAcctAssgmtDistribution = _AcctAssgmtDistrIndicatorText.MultipleAcctAssgmtDistribution


//  association [0..1] to I_PurchaseRequisitionItemAPI01 as _PurReqItem                   on  $projection.PurchaseRequisition     = _PurReqItem.PurchaseRequisition
//                                                                                        and $projection.PurchaseRequisitionItem = _PurReqItem.PurchaseRequisitionItem

  association        to parent ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP_H      as _Header                       on  $projection.ParentUUID = _Header.UUID

  composition [0..*] of ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP_A             as _AccAssignment
{
  key   uuid                                              as UUID,
        parent_uuid                                       as ParentUUID,
        file_uuid                                         as FileUUID,
        purchase_order                                    as PurchaseOrder,
        item                                              as Item,
        concat_with_space('Item:',ltrim( item, '0' ),1)   as LabelItem,
        material                                          as Material,
        _MaterialText.ProductName                         as MaterialName,
        plant                                             as Plant,
        _Plant.PlantName                                  as PlantName,
        document_currency                                 as DocumentCurrency,
        purchase_order_quantity_unit                      as PurchaseOrderQuantityUnit,
        net_price_amount                                  as NetPriceAmount,
        order_quantity                                    as OrderQuantity,
        purchase_requisition                              as PurchaseRequisition,
        purchase_requisition_item                         as PurchaseRequisitionItem,
        base_unit                                         as BaseUnit,
        multiple_acct_assgmt_distribut                    as MultipleAcctAssgmtDistribution,
        _AcctAssgmtDistrIndicatorText.DistributionKeyText as DistributionKeyText,
        account_assignment_category                       as AccountAssignmentCategory,
        tax_code                                          as TaxCode,
        purchase_contract                                 as PurchaseContract,
        purchase_contract_item                            as PurchaseContractItem,
        goods_receipt_is_expected                         as GoodsReceiptIsExpected,
        invoice_is_goods_receipt_b                        as InvoiceIsGoodsReceiptBased,
//        _PurReqItem.PurReqnReleaseStatus                  as PurReqnReleaseStatus,
        $session.system_language                          as Language,
        local_created_by                                  as LocalCreatedBy,
        local_created_at                                  as LocalCreatedAt,
        local_last_changed_by                             as LocalLastChangedBy,
        local_last_changed_at                             as LocalLastChangedAt,
        last_changed_at                                   as LastChangedAt,
        //Associations
        _Header,
        _File,
        _AccAssignment
}
